## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Shēnrì jīng* (T535) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra by Dharmarakṣa 竺法護 ([竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7)). *Shēnrì* 申日 may transliterate Sanskrit *Sundaya* or another personal name. The text is closely related to [KR6i0164](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0164) *Yuèguāng tóngzǐ jīng* — Shēnrì is the elder, and Yuèguāng is his son.

**Abstract**

The Shēnrì-Yuèguāng narrative pair (T535 + T534) belongs to the same Indic source-tradition. The doctrinal kernel is the Candraprabha-kumāra prophecy. Translation dated to Dharmarakṣa's productive period (266–308 CE).
